algorithm.title: Fetal alcohol syndrome evaluation and management

nodes.text: Recognize diagnostic triad: prenatal/postnatal growth restriction + characteristic facial dysmorphisms + CNS neurodevelopmental deficits
Identify facial features: smooth philtrum + thin vermilion border + short palpebral fissures
**Differentiate from Down syndrome:** normal ear placement and absence of macroglossia
**Cardiac murmur or structural concern:** obtain echocardiogram for septal defects
Screen for neurodevelopmental delays: speech, occupational, and behavioral therapy
Coordinate long-term educational support and multidisciplinary family resources
